title: Study of Residuals Deformities After Diaphyseal Femoral Fracture in Children Treated by Skin Traction
official: Study of Residuals Deformities After Diaphyseal Femoral Fracture in Children Treated by Skin Traction
summary: Diaphyseal femoral fracture in children \<6 years old are treated by the skin traction technique. As demonstrated by numerous studies, given the significant potential for bone remodeling in young children, remodeling (excluding rotational disorder) allows anatomical correction. The aim of this study is to confirm, via EOS imaging, the absence of residual deformities 3 years after the end of treatment in children treated in Amiens hospital department.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* \<6 years old at the time of the fracture
* treatment by skin zenith traction
* femoral shaft fracture, traumatic, unilateral

Exclusion Criteria:

* Multiple fracture
* pathological fracture
* history of lower limb fracture
* contraindication to zenith traction
